semanticChecks.method: Reviewed each locale field against its Japanese canonical text. No peer output read.
semanticChecks.coverage: All titles, full paragraphs, questions, terminology and illustration alt texts translated without summaries.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndNegations: Preserved the differences between availability, condition, specification, compatibility, setup and approval; preserved unreceived/unconfirmed/unmeasured states and prohibitions on using conceptual examples as procedures.
semanticChecks.technicalUncertainty: Kept not-all and possibility statements for stepladder conversion, standard rail equipment, suction-compatible blower models and unintended dust dispersal.
semanticChecks.numbers: Source numeric tokens checked per field and locale with required regex; spelled-out source counts remained written words.
semanticChecks.terminology: Reviewed ladder rungs/supports/displacement/corrosion, stepladder top boards/spread limiting parts, portable work platforms/handholds/guardrails, mobile tower scaffolds/casters, aerial platform floor height/training, broom/dustpan collection, blower/suction/dust collection.
semanticChecks.finalCorrections: Changed opening-limiter terminology to 开度限制装置/開度限制裝置 to avoid implying the part prevents all opening. Changed blower to 鼓风机/鼓風機 to avoid confusion with hair dryers.
semanticChecks.sourceOnlyScope: No load values, legal height limits, assembly sequences, operating instructions or extra safety requirements added.

limitations: Self-review only; no native-language reviewer or independent engineering review.
